name: Pinball Arcade: F-14 Tomcat
storyline: F-14 Tomcat (1987) is another fantastic design from Steve Ritchie and was the top selling pinball game of 1987. Featuring a fighter jet theme, players take on the role of a top ace engaged in aerial combat with the ultimate goal being to take down their electronic adversary, General Yagov. The table features high speed gameplay, highlighted by the fastest shot in pinball, the Yagov Kicker. This device fires the ball back at the flippers and was the first of its kind. This table was also the first to have a ball save feature, which gives the ball back to players after a premature drain. Approximately 14,502 units of this table were produced.
